description: This file implements the GLES1Renderer class, which manages rendering operations for OpenGL ES 1.x within the ANGLE project. It includes methods for shader compilation, program linking, setting uniforms, and rendering textures, as well as managing renderer state and external shader dependencies.

classes.name: GLES1Renderer
classes.description: Manages OpenGL ES 1.x rendering, including shader compilation, program linking, uniform setting, and texture drawing.

methods.name: prepareForDraw
methods.description: Prepares the renderer for drawing by setting uniforms and state based on current GL state and mode.

methods.name: compileShader
methods.description: Compiles a shader of given type from source code.

methods.name: linkProgram
methods.description: Links vertex and fragment shaders into a shader program with attribute locations.

methods.name: initializeRendererProgram
methods.description: Initializes the renderer shader program if not already initialized.

methods.name: setUniform1i
methods.description: Sets a uniform integer value in the shader program.

methods.name: setUniform1iv
methods.description: Sets multiple uniform integer values in the shader program.

methods.name: setUniform4fv
methods.description: Sets a uniform array of 4-component float vectors.

methods.name: setUniform3fv
methods.description: Sets a uniform array of 3-component float vectors.

methods.name: setUniform2fv
methods.description: Sets a uniform array of 2-component float vectors.

methods.name: setAttributesEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables vertex attribute arrays based on a mask.
